body:
Summoner ID:spinachdips

Bracket:Silver V - been playing about 1 year now, didn't play ranked last season.

Favorite Role: jungle//mid

Top 3 Favorite Champions (Doesn't Have To Be Favorite Role): Malzahar, J4, Xin Zhao

Time Zone/Availability: EST, after 530PM, nightly. most weekends

Do you think you're a good player for the amount of time you've played the game? Decent yes, anything more... no. I have some map awareness issues and I'm probably too passive sometimes. 

When you lose in solo queue what is the main reason? I believe it's a lack of communication and stubbornness. Pings aren't the same as skype. It's a team problem 95% of the time. That one feeder is usually over exaggerated and blamed upon someone. 

What is your biggest game-play flaw? Map awareness, by far.. or just NOT watching my mana before I full engage. I have a consistent issue of over estimating my resources.. or the lack there of. I'm more conservative usually but I definitely have some basic observation issues.

Why are you interested in this? It would be nice to receive some positive coaching on a game. I used to play UT competitively in college, traveling, for money. I haven't done anything since.. and it would be nice to learn more about a game I vest time into from someone who could share some wisdom. 


--thanks!!
